Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows bilateral consolidation with multiple cystic lucencies (pseudocavitation) in the right midzone, a pattern highly characteristic of pneumonic-type lung adenocarcinoma (formerly bronchioloalveolar carcinoma), which can mimic pneumonia but features air-filled spaces within tumor tissue rather than true necrotic cavities.
